user.title: Set up Since
user.description: Only the users you pick here can see or change your Since data. Everyone else, admins included, is refused by the server. Note that anyone who can open the config folder can still read the storage file.

data_description.notify_service: Pick your phone's notify service, for example notify.mobile_app_joes_iphone. Leave empty for no reminders.
